_about: One lens of the public map: the outcomes of a registered QCTO qualification. This file shows which outcomes AMU's published Business Problems develop. Outcome codes and text are the qualification's own public record; the mapping is AMU's claim about its curriculum, evidenced in the governed matrices. Only outcomes developed by published Business Problems appear here; the qualification's full record lives in its module pages.
